result.topic_en: Draft notes on the definition of continuity of a function: a quantity z varies continuously with x in an interval if every infinitely small change of x produces an infinitely small change of z, expressed with an arbitrary given ε and a subdivision into small intervals; it ends with a remark about continuous functions and infinitely many oscillations.
